content:
“Scavenged and restored by Appalachia's vicious and anarchistic gangs, Raider Power Armor features crude plating, rusty spikes, and significant battlefield protection.”— *Fallout 76* loading screen

**Raider Power Armor** is a variant of Power Armor in *Fallout 76*.

## Background[edit]

This power armor was made by raiders from salvaged materials. It is found in five levels, 10, 20, 30, 40, and 50 with increasing protection. It is the only power armor equippable below level 25. It is found on Power Armor Chassis at various sites in Appalachia; see power armor locations. It has a distinctive Raider style. 

### Armor Parts[edit]

Damage resistance totals are for the armor only, e.g. the 60 bonus to each resistance from the Power Armor Chassis is not included.
